newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil's Mizushima topper to close May 18.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil's Mizushima topper to close May 18.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday it would close its 130,000 barrel-per-day crude distillation unit (CDU) at the Mizushima refinery in western Japan from May 18 to June 21 for routine maintenance work.
Other major secondary refining facilities to be closed for maintenance checks are as follows:
Catalytic cracker 11,000 end-May to early July
Catalytic reformer 18,500 early May to early July
Direct desulphuriser 45,000 early March to end-April

Mitsubishi Oil's 75,000 bpd topper at the Kawasaki refinery is due to close in September for routine maintenance work.
